We've identified that the pgbouncer connection pool was exhausted, which is likely causing some of the job failures. The pgbouncer restart will resolve this issue and ensure that the connection pool is operational again.

Before we restart the pgbouncer service, I will confirm the current status of the jobs service and check for any immediate issues that might arise after the restart.

I will first restart the pgbouncer service in the prod namespace to clear the exhausted connection pool.
